description_en: Queries the services integrated with Cloud Config and their integration statuses
description_zh: 查询配置审计集成的服务列表及其状态
name: ListIntegratedService

Data.description_en: The information about the services that can be integrated

items.description_en: The information about the services that can be integrated

AggregatorDeliveryDataType.description_en:
The types of cross-account integrated events. Supported event types:

NonCompliantNotification: Non-compliance event
AggregatorDeliveryDataType.description_zh:
跨账号集成的事件类型。支持的事件类型有：
NonCompliantNotification：不合规事件

IntegratedTypes.description_en:
The types of integrated events. Multiple event types are separated by commas (,). Supported event types:

ConfigurationItemChangeNotification: Resource change event.
NonCompliantNotification: Non-compliance event
IntegratedTypes.description_zh:
集成的事件类型，多个事件类型用半角逗号（,）分隔。支持的事件类型有：

ConfigurationItemChangeNotification：资源变更事件。
NonCompliantNotification：不合规事件

ServiceCode.description_en:
The identifier of the cloud service that can be integrated. Valid values:

eventbridge: EventBridge.

cms: CloudMonitor.

bpstudio: Cloud Architect
ServiceCode.description_zh:
可集成云服务标识。取值：

eventbridge：事件总线。

cms：云监控。

bpstudio：云速搭

Status.description_en:
The integration status of the cloud service. Valid values:

true: Integrated.

false: Not integrated
Status.description_zh:
云服务的集成状态。取值：

true：已集成。

false：未集成
